### Question-type checklist (aim for a mix)

- [ ] At least 6 workhorse (your top 3 categories, ~2 each)
- [ ] Exactly 1 red line (costs you if it fails)
- [ ] 1 weak-spot question (the thing it usually fumbles)
- [ ] 1 messy/realistic phrasing question
- [ ] 1 new-frontier question (distrustful area you're monitoring)
- [ ] At least 2 boundary-style questions anywhere in the ten ("if you don't know, say so") — scatter them in
- [ ] Every task question has a one-sentence acceptance bar written under it
- [ ] You could grade every answer in ~15 seconds

## How to keep this file stable

- Edit questions only during a scheduled quarterly review, or when you retire/add one on purpose (note the date above).
- If given material is referenced (a mock email, a sample paragraph), keep that material **inside this file** so inputs never drift.
- Retiring a question? Mark it `RETIRED (date)` and add the replacement as a new number with a note. Expect 1–2 weeks of fuzzy comparisons afterward.
